posts.author: JohnFP
posts.content_md:
Kris, I am going to have to give that a try. I have been using black electrical tape but I have found on more then one occasion that the tape peels away from the plate while it is settling just prior to exposure. This mostly happens on thin plates so this method would be very good.

Is it removable with a damp or dry cloth? Damp would still be ok.
